reason: I only pay when the thing is in my hand. You want the item price and your fee before anything leaves China, and my cousin already lost a deposit to a page that vanished, so I am not sending Zain Cash to a new service I have never heard of.
objection: Paying up front to a brand new page. If you disappear, my money is gone. And 13,000 a kilo on top makes a cheap cable or phone case cost more in fees than the item itself.
would_change_my_mind: Full cash on delivery, nothing paid before it reaches my door, or at least a real office I can walk into and people I know who got their orders.
